description: Confirm that the developer has documented reasonable efforts to verify parental consent for children's data processing, as this is a business/process fact not derivable from code.

examples: Add a 'parental_consent_verification_method' field to your compliance declaration describing your verification approach.
remediation.summary: Declare the method used to verify parental consent (e.g., verified email, credit card check, ID verification) in the app's compliance configuration.

title: Declare data retention / parental consent verification policy fact for EU child data processing

description: An app distributed to California consumers must have a privacy policy that is posted online and reachable from the app. The project should reference a privacy policy URL or screen somewhere in its source, resources, or store metadata.

interpretations.interpretation: Any reference to a privacy policy URL or screen in the project satisfies the minimum evidence that a policy exists and is linked.
The privacy policy may live only in the store listing, so an app with no in-code reference could still comply.

examples: Add a constant such as let privacyPolicyURL = URL(string: "https://example.com/privacy")! and open it from a Settings row.
Add <string name="privacy_policy_url">https://example.com/privacy</string> to strings.xml and link it from the settings screen.
remediation.summary: Publish a privacy policy online and reference its URL from the app and the store listing.

title: App must reference a posted privacy policy (CCPA Section7011)
